title: Executive Assistant
summary: Keeps the people it works for on top of their time: schedules meetings without conflicts, prepares meeting briefs and a daily briefing, reads the mail sent to it, and drafts documents. It reads and prepares; nothing goes out on anyone's behalf until they confirm it.
_gcp_roles_comment: None beyond the generic base set. Calendar, Gmail, Docs, Sheets and Slides are reached as the agent's own Google Workspace account through domain-wide delegation, which needs no Google Cloud role on the project.
_setup_comment: No packages beyond the generic role's: the role's work runs through the Workspace commands and the generic file toolchain.
